entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-06-03
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Issue disposing a component's JS complement in a Blazor Web App using mixed render modes #62230
  • "The path is not of a legal form" error when adding ASP.NET Core Angular project to existing solution #62227
  • Allow to bind records with both primary constructor and properties via AsParameters #62226
  • WebApplicationFactory.Services throws Exception with new UseKestrel API #62224
  • E2E tests are not running #62223
    10.0-preview6
  • Manage Session in blazor server app #62220
  • Metric for connected circuits drops to zero when a client disconnects #62219
    10.0-preview6

Closed

  • Perf regression: json #62221
  • Client-side fingerprinting does not work correctly after publishing #62211
  • [dotnet-sdk-10.0.100-preview.5.25272.110] Fail to launch Blazor-Blogs App with System.InvalidOperationException after retargeting #62171
  • Issue related to the silentRequestTimeout in AuthenticationService.js (Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.WebAssembly.Authentication) #62157
  • Perf improvement: json #62207

PullRequests

Created

  • [MVC.Testing] Fix NullReferenceException #62231
    area-mvc, community-contribution, feature-mvc-testing

    area-blazor, 10.0-preview6
  • [Blazor] Root preload URLs #62225
    area-blazor, 10.0-preview6
  • [WIP] Find workaround for `dotnet test` failing to discover tests #62222

Merged

    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:, javascript, dependencies

    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:, 10.0-preview6

    Attention: Shared Code Modified

    area-identity
  • Feature for setting activity tags on creation #62090
    community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun, area-networking

    feature-httpsys, area-networking

    area-networking

    feature-iis, feature-kestrel, feature-httpsys, area-networking
